name: Hogwarts Castle
description: A vast, drafty castle of towers, staircases that move, and portraits that gossip. Its four houses each keep a common room, and most of the school's life happens in its corridors.

name: Great Hall
description: Four long house tables under an enchanted ceiling that mirrors the sky outside. Meals, the Sorting, and school announcements all happen here.

name: Grand Staircase
description: A set of staircases that rearrange themselves while you climb them. Some doors open only when you are not looking at them.

name: Library
description: Tall shelves, quiet study tables, and books that bite. The restricted section is kept locked, and the librarian is strict about it.

name: Hospital Wing
description: Beds behind curtains, and Madam Pomfrey, who can mend most injuries and has opinions about how they were got.

name: Quidditch Pitch
description: A great oval of grass with three goal hoops at each end and stands for the spectators. Practices and matches are held here whatever the weather.

name: Great Lake
description: Cold, dark water at the foot of the castle grounds. A giant squid is said to live beneath it, and the boathouse sits on its shore.

name: Forbidden Forest
description: Ancient trees that block out the sky, and creatures that are not all friendly. Students are forbidden to enter it without permission, and most of them find a reason to try anyway.

name: Hogsmeade
description: The only all-wizard village in Britain, just beyond the school gates. Shops along a single cobbled street sell sweets, robes, joke products, and books, and the village is open to older students on weekends.

name: The Three Broomsticks
description: A busy pub with a fire, butterbeer, and a mix of students and locals. Its regulars hear everything that happens in the village, and some of it is true.
